title: GSF third-party managed Krystal Resort Puerto Vallarta
text: HOTEL announces expansion of Krystal Puerto Vallarta (third-party owned). Third-party owned hotels managed by the Company: 13 Krystal Resort Puerto Vallarta, 420 rooms. Management Fees related to third-party owned hotels. Do not attach Resort ownership to Krystal Grand Puerto Vallarta. Chartwell owns Krystal Resort Puerto Vallarta; GSF manages it.
